explanation: Oxygen makes up nearly half the crust's mass, locked into rocks as oxides and silicates. Quartz, for example, is silicon dioxide, and silicon comes second at about 28%.
learnMore: Abundance of elements in Earth's crust

claims.text: Oxygen is the most abundant element in Earth's crust by mass.
Silicon, iron and aluminium each make up less of Earth's crust by mass than oxygen does.
Oxygen makes up nearly half of the mass of Earth's crust, mostly bound in oxides and silicates.
Silicon is the second most abundant element in Earth's crust by mass, at about 28%.
